rules.statement: A nominated successor fails to succeed to the land held on a permit if they do not enter into possession within a specified period.
rules.supporting_quote: That would be either within six months from the date the spouse fails to succeed to the land, that is within 12 months reckoned from the date of the death of the permit- holder, or within six months of the death of such spouse.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 68 of the Land Development Ordinance
